references.title: NIST SP 811, section 8.7
references.scope: Power ratios and decibel definition; does not establish fibre attenuation coefficients.

references.title: BIPM SI metre definition
references.scope: Exact vacuum speed of light; fibre group index 1.468 remains a configured assumption.

references.title: Bennett et al., Purification of Noisy Entanglement
references.scope: Ideal bilateral CNOT and equal target outcomes on independent Werner inputs; no local gate noise calibration.

references.title: Duer, Briegel, Cirac and Zoller, Quantum repeaters based on entanglement purification
references.scope: Ideal entanglement connection of independent Bell-diagonal pairs; reference implements Pauli-label composition, no measured BSM efficiency or noisy operation validation.

references.title: Qiskit Aer depolarizing channel definition
references.scope: Isotropic channel towards I/4; exponential rate is a model assumption, not measured T1/T2.

references.title: NASA Basics of Space Flight, Planetary Orbits
references.scope: Ideal two-body circular orbit. Spherical Earth radius 6371 km, GM 398600.4418 km^3/s^2 and Earth spin 7.2921159e-5 rad/s are explicit legacy model parameters; no TLE, SGP4 or ephemeris calibration.

references.title: Gavignet et al., QKD and DWDM co-propagation
references.scope: Existing six transcribed published means; descriptive integrity check only, no raw observations or uncertainties, no fit to these reduced repeater models.
